method.window: Use frozen driver [start,end) sample range; select known-game RAF requests that entered from the first body sample RAF entry to the end-boundary sample RAF entry. Inventory never-entered requests separately. Unknown/non-game and outside-body requests remain in the raw report, outside this timing denominator.
method.legacyWatermark: sample[4] is retained as legacyStatsWatermark, not interpreted as the continuous actual remote input frontier. Use networkPacing F/A/outstanding for that distinction.
method.registeredWait: enteredAt - requestedAt; includes any remainder of the parent callback.
method.availableDispatchWait: enteredAt - max(requestedAt,parent.exitedAt); a dispatch waiting interval, not proof that the browser or CPU was idle.
method.observedActive: Associated game frame was active and not ended; hooks current; request completed without cancel/exception; explicit requested pause 0 at entry/exit and parent exit; visible lifecycle through wait; no pause/stop call during wait.
method.boundary: First selected request may have been registered before the body. End-boundary request is outside the body. Driver end/crossing new-state gaps are retained separately.
method.causality: CPU, other JavaScript, OS scheduling, browser refresh policy and remote input arrival need independent attribution. No scheduling-cause, physical display or general no-stall guarantee.
method.filtering: All game requests and exclusion counts are retained. Active-only timing is a named subset, not a replacement for all-body evidence.
method.thresholds: 50/100/250ms are descriptive counts, not an automatic acceptance rule.
